product.olivetti-notebook-a12.summary: The entry-level Olivetti 1. notebook with an 80286.
product.olivetti-notebook-a12.history: In September 1991 Olivetti offered the Notebook A12 in the Olivetti 1. line. The Historical Archive attributes development of the range to Triumph-Adler with Y-E Data collaboration and locates production in Nuremberg.
product.olivetti-notebook-a12.architectu: The format explains the differences in weight and expansion. The catalogue specifies 2.5 kg and 297 × 210 × 52 mm, with an integrated mouse and 1.44 MB floppy drive.
product.olivetti-notebook-a12.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-notebook-a12.limitation: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
